svg.title: One output cell of the feature map, worked out in full
svg.desc: A six by six picture whose left half holds 10s and right half holds 2s, with the top-left three by three window outlined. Beside it a three by three kernel of 1, 0 and minus 1, and a four by four feature map whose second cell, outlined, holds 24. The callout shows one row giving 1 times 10 plus 0 times 10 plus minus 1 times 2 equals 8, and three rows giving 8 plus 8 plus 8 equals 24. A side panel counts the windows: 6 minus 3 plus 1 is 4 across and 4 down, so 4 times 4 is 16 cells.
svg.text: Slide, multiply, add. One cell at a time.

g.text: three rows: 8 + 8 + 8 = 24, so this output cell is 24

svg.text: the kernel never changes as it slides:
the same nine numbers do all 16 sums
